parameters.name: _SESSION['auth']
parameters.rationale: Primary authentication flag set to 'yes' on successful login in login.php (line 91). Checked in auth.php (line 32) as the main gate for all admin pages.

parameters.name: _SESSION['username']
parameters.rationale: Stores authenticated username set during login (login.php line 88). Used for identity tracking in logging and as author for new content.

parameters.name: _SESSION['userID']
parameters.rationale: Stores the database user ID from the users table, set during login (login.php line 89). Used for logging operations.

parameters.name: _SESSION['permissions']
parameters.rationale: Comma-separated permission string (12 positions: createranks,manageranks,loginrecords,preferences,loggingin,createarticles,approve,editarticles,deletearticles,createusers,editusers,deleteusers). Assigned to $globalvars['rank'] array in auth.php (line 42). Checked throughout admin pages to authorize specific operations.

parameters.name: _SESSION['path']
parameters.rationale: Path verification token set during login (login.php line 92). Checked in auth.php (line 37) to prevent session fixation/hijacking by comparing against current directory path.

parameters.name: rank
parameters.rationale: Aliased from $_SESSION['permissions'] to $globalvars['rank'] array. Each index maps to a specific permission: [0]=create_ranks, [2]=manage_ranks, [4]=login_records, [6]=preferences, [8]=logging_in, [10]=create_articles, [12]=approve, [14]=edit_articles, [16]=delete_articles, [18]=create_users, [20]=edit_users, [22]=delete_users.

parameters.name: $globalvars['rank'][2]
parameters.rationale: Controls rank-management operations and redirects denied requests to permissiondenied.

parameters.name: $globalvars['rank'][4]
parameters.rationale: Controls access to login records and redirects denied requests to permissiondenied.

parameters.name: $globalvars['rank'][6]
parameters.rationale: Controls preference management and redirects denied requests to permissiondenied.

parameters.name: $globalvars['rank'][10]
parameters.rationale: Controls article creation and redirects denied requests to permissiondenied.

parameters.name: $globalvars['rank'][14]
parameters.rationale: Controls article editing and redirects denied requests to permissiondenied.

parameters.name: $globalvars['rank'][16]
parameters.rationale: Controls article deletion and redirects denied requests to permissiondenied.

parameters.name: $globalvars['rank'][18]
parameters.rationale: Controls user creation and redirects denied requests to permissiondenied.

parameters.name: $globalvars['rank'][20]
parameters.rationale: Controls user editing and redirects denied requests to permissiondenied.

parameters.name: $globalvars['rank'][22]
parameters.rationale: Controls user deletion and redirects denied requests to permissiondenied.
